title: First-Touch Boarding: From Zero to Reserved Capacity — Illustrations, Micro-interactions, and Heuristics
creator: Ariana Chen
description:
Purpose: Create a coherent, developer-focused set of visuals and small interactive assets that take a user from an empty Dedicated account to a validated Reserved Capacity state. This ticket covers art assets, annotated screenshots, micro-interactions for provisioning states, and a heuristic explainer for autoscaling and SLA expectations.

Background: Current onboarding flows show form fields and checklist items but lack illustrative affordances that explain the tradeoffs between reserved capacity sizes, burst options, and SLA bands. Engineering needs precise asset specs (SVGs, Lottie), annotated image overlays for the Console release notes, and copy suggestions for small inline tooltips.

Deliverables (explicit):
- High-fidelity illustration series (3 sizes: hero, card, micro) showing "Empty -> Estimate -> Reserve -> Serving" states (SVG + PNG exports).
- 4 small Lottie micro-interactions for provisioning states: queued, allocating, warming KV cache, ready. Each with duration and loop rules.
- Annotated screenshot set for Console: provisioning modal, autoscale policy composer, SLA summary card, fallback routing panel. Each screenshot must include 3 overlay callouts with copy and pointer arrows.
- A one-page heuristic card that visually maps expected latency/cost/SLA tradeoffs for small/medium/large reserved pools (used as in-console explainer and docs hero).
- Microcopy pack (strings) for inline tooltips, empty states, CTAs, and error states (i18n-ready: plain English keys and short character limits).
- Accessibility checklist and color-token mapping (contrast ratios and WCAG notes for every visual).

Acceptance criteria:
- Figma file with named pages and exported assets in the design delivery folder.
- Dev-ready asset zip containing SVGs, optimized PNGs, Lotties, and a small README with animation usage notes and recommended CSS classes.
- Annotated screenshots delivered as individual numbered PNGs and a composite PDF for docs insertion.
- Microcopy reviewed and signed off by PM and Eng; includes fallback strings for network failures.
- Design review meeting scheduled and recorded; feedback acted upon or surfaced as follow-up tickets.

Out of scope: Copy translations, full localization QA, backend instrumentation changes, implementing autoscale logic.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Lottie complexity may not match Console render constraints. Mitigation: provide static PNG fallback and simplified JSON Lottie variant.
- Risk: Autoscale heuristic visualization could be misinterpreted as guaranteed SLA. Mitigation: include a clear disclaimer and link to SLA policy in the visual footer.

Notes for engineering: Provide exact modal dimensions, safe area padding, and the CSS grid breakpoint values to avoid re-renders. If the Console team changes token names before delivery, a quick token-mapping step will be scheduled as a follow-up.
